Updates `sass` from 1.104.1 to 1.105.0
<details>
<summary>Release notes</summary>
<p><em>Sourced from <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">sass's releases</a>.</em></p>
<blockquote>
<h2>Dart Sass 1.105.0</h2>
<p>To install Sass 1.105.0, download one of the packages below and <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: katiek2.github.io]">add it to your PATH</a>, or see <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: sass-lang.com]">the Sass website</a> for full installation instructions.</p>
<h1>Changes</h1>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Add support for first-class modules. These can be accessed using the new <code>meta.load()</code> and <code>meta.get-module()</code> functions, and may be passed as the <code>$module</code> argument to numerous eisting <code>sass:meta</code> functions.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Add the <code>meta.css()</code> mixin, which includes CSS from a first-class module.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3>JS API</h3>
<ul>
<li>Add a <code>SassModule</code> class and a corresponding <code>Value.assertModule()</code> method.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Dart API</h3>
<ul>
<li>Add a <code>SassModule</code> class and a corresponding <code>Value.assertModule()</code> method.</li>
</ul>
<p>See the <a href="[QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]">full changelog</a> for changes in earlier releases.</p>
</blockquote>
</details>
